lineage: NEW BENCHMARK — pure displacement with (K/2)(ln J)^2 volumetric SED for BOTH FEBio and SfePy. Created in Round 88 per Option B of the mixed-vs-penalty decision (MIXED-VS-PENALTY-DECISION.json). NOT a silent modification of B002 or B004.
supersedes: NONE — B004 remains the analytical reference benchmark; B005 is the cross-solver comparison target
freeze_principle: All 10 fields below are frozen BEFORE either solver is executed. The analytical reference is derived INDEPENDENTLY (same as B004, since B005 uses the same constitutive law). After freeze, no field may be modified without an explicit re-freeze record and version bump.

field_1_geometry.reference_configuration: undeformed cube, x in [0,1], y in [0,1], z in [0,1]

field_2_material_equation.formulation: Total Lagrangian, PURE DISPLACEMENT (no mixed u-p)
field_2_material_equation.formulation_choice_rationale: Both FEBio and SfePy can implement this formulation in pure displacement. FEBio via uncoupled neo-Hookean with custom volumetric law or user material; SfePy via dw_tl_he_neohook + dw_tl_bulk_logJ_v2 (custom term with correct stress AND tangent, verified Round 88c).

field_4_boundary_conditions.lateral_contraction: FREE in x and y on all faces except where pinned below
field_4_boundary_conditions.corner_full_pin: Corner at origin (0,0,0) is implicitly fully pinned via the three face pins above
field_4_boundary_conditions.free_faces: Right face (x=1), Back face (y=1) — fully free

field_5_loading_path.load_ramp: linear in pseudo-time, from 0.0 at t=0 to 0.1 at t=1
field_5_loading_path.time_stepping_for_solve: n_step = 2 (single load step from 0 to 1.0 in pseudo-time)

field_6_observable.definition: Cauchy stress zz-component at the single integration point of the single element, at the final pseudo-time t=1.0
field_6_observable.extraction_method_for_sfepy: evaluate stress via term_mode='stress', push forward via sigma = (1/J) F S F^T
field_6_observable.extraction_method_for_febio: Read cell_data['stress'][:,2] from VTK output at final timestep. FEBio outputs Cauchy stress directly.

field_7_analytical_reference.derivation_independence_statement: Derived from constitutive model and BCs alone. Same derivation as B004 (since B005 uses the same constitutive law). The analytical reference is NOT derived from solver output.
field_7_analytical_reference.sigma_zz_analytical_precision: verified to 0.0001% by scipy brentq root-finding

field_8_tolerance.tolerance_application: max(|FEBio - analytical| / |analytical|, |SfePy - analytical| / |analytical|, |FEBio - SfePy| / |analytical|) < primary_tolerance for L3-PASS-MINIMUM; < secondary_tolerance for L3-PASS-STRONG
field_8_tolerance.tolerance_freeze_note: Frozen BEFORE FEBio execution. Will NOT be relaxed if FEBio disagrees.

field_9_convergence_criterion.sfepy_convergence_required: final residual absolute < 1e-10 OR final residual relative < 1e-6
field_9_convergence_criterion.sfepy_custom_term: dw_tl_bulk_logJ_v2 (overrides BOTH stress_function AND tan_mod_function with correct log-J formulas)
field_9_convergence_criterion.febio_material_model_REQUIRED: MUST use a pure-displacement material with (K/2)(ln J)^2 volumetric SED. Options: (a) FEBio uncoupled neo-Hookean with custom volumetric; (b) FEBio user-defined material plugin; (c) FEBio coupled neo-Hookean if it can be shown to reduce to pure displacement under these BCs (would require proof, not assumed).
field_9_convergence_criterion.convergence_criterion_freeze_note: All solver settings frozen. Will NOT be tuned to make a failing solver pass.

field_10_domain_path_coverage.description: Per CEO Round 87: 'the coder's five tangent states need to cover the actual deformation path and neighborhood used by the solver. Otherwise the machine could prove equivalence at five convenient points while missing a divergence between them.'

integrated_normalized_trajectory_error.definition: integral of |sigma_solver(t) - sigma_analytical(t)| / |sigma_analytical(t)| dt, divided by total path length

integrated_tangent_trajectory_error.definition: integral of |D_solver(t) - D_analytical(t)| / |D_analytical(t)| dt, divided by total path length

trajectory_shape_checks: Monotonicity: sigma_zz must be monotonically increasing in lambda_z
Curvature: d2(sigma_zz)/d(lambda_z)^2 must be negative (concave, i.e., stiffening decreases)
No spurious oscillations: solver trajectories must not oscillate around the analytical trajectory

freeze_signature.method: self-signed by CTO mode at freeze time
key_invariants: B005 is a NEW benchmark, not a silent modification of B002 or B004.
B005 uses pure displacement for BOTH solvers (no mixed u-p).
B005 uses (K/2)(ln J)^2 volumetric SED (matches FEBio default).
Analytical reference derived BEFORE any solver execution on B005.
All tolerance thresholds frozen BEFORE any solver execution on B005.
Domain coverage requires 11 sample points (not just 5).
All 10 fields immutable without explicit re-freeze record.

post_freeze_allowed_actions: Run SfePy at 11 sample points along loading path
Configure FEBio with pure-displacement (K/2)(ln J)^2 volumetric SED material
Run FEBio at 11 sample points along loading path
Compute trajectory metrics (max error, integrated error) for both solvers
Three-way comparison: Analytical ↔ FEBio ↔ SfePy, at 11 points, for stress AND tangent
post_freeze_forbidden_actions: Modify any of the 10 fields without an explicit L3-BENCHMARK-005-v1.1.0 re-freeze record
Use FEBio output to retroactively adjust the analytical reference
Use SfePy output to retroactively adjust the analytical reference
Relax any tolerance threshold if a solver disagrees
Reduce the sample count from 11 to fewer points
Skip the trajectory shape checks (monotonicity, curvature, oscillation)
